issue.body:
Now we can remove `_th_potri`!

Compared to the original TH-based `cholesky_inverse`, complex (https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/33152) and batched inputs (https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/7500) are now supported both on CPU and CUDA.

Closes https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/24685.
Closes https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/24543.

Ref. https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/49421, https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/42666

issue.body:
This issue tracks work related to improving PyTorch's test suite. 

**Deprecations**

- [ ] Remove assertEqualIgnoreTypes (see https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/38095)

**Test Suites needing updates**
- [ ] test_binary_ufuncs.py
  - [ ] needs structured "forward testing" analogous to test_unary_ufuncs.py
  - [ ] needs automated type promotion testing
- [ ] test_reductions.py
  - [ ] needs structured "forward testing" analogous to test_unary_ufuncs.py  (https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/49746)

**OpInfo-related improvements**
- [ ] Fix ops failing test_out

**General Framework Improvements**
- [ ] Re-run failing CUDA tests with CUDA launch blocking (https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/49023)
- [ ] Add an option to run only tests for a specific device type (https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/44159)
- [ ] Debug and fix test suite memory issues (https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/43677)

**NN Module Testing**
- [x] Add "ModuleInfos" analogous to OpInfos to facilitate systemic testing
- [ ] Refactor test_nn.py to be fewer than 10k lines (https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/42847)
- [ ] Reduce the time taken by test_ReplicationPad3d (https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/38190)
- [ ] Reduce the time taken by test_LocalResponseNorm_3d_custom_params (https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/38189)
- [ ] Reduce the time taken by test_interpolate_nearest_scale_3d (https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/38188)
- [ ] Review convolution testing (https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/6135)

issue.title: OpInfo tests fail gradcheck for ops with TensorList inputs.

labels.name: module: autograd
labels.description: Related to torch.autograd, and the autograd engine in general

labels.name: module: tests
labels.description: Issues related to tests (not the torch.testing module)

labels.name: triaged
labels.description: This issue has been looked at a team member, and triaged and prioritized into an appropriate module

labels.name: module: linear algebra
labels.description: Issues related to specialized linear algebra operations in PyTorch; includes matrix multiply matmul

repository.name: pytorch
repository.description: Tensors and Dynamic neural networks in Python with strong GPU acceleration

issue.body:
For ops like ``torch.stack`` and ``torch.linalg.multi_dot`` that take a ``Tensor[]`` as input as opposed to a single Tensor, OpInfo testing does not work properly.

If the `sample_inputs_func` returns a tuple of tensors per SampleInput, it will be passed as individual positional parameters to the op. If instead each SampleInput is returned with a list, then gradcheck will fail with the following error:

```
FAILED test/test_ops.py::TestGradientsCPU::test_fn_grad_linalg_multi_dot_cpu_float64 - ValueError: gradcheck expects at least one input tensor to require gradient, but none of the them have requires_grad=True.
```

The current workaround is to create a lambda as follows:
```
op=lambda *args, out=None: torch.linalg.multi_dot([*args], out=out),
```

However, this is changing the actual op which can cause problems in the future, for instance, when comparing the results of the op against NumPy.

cc @ezyang @albanD @zou3519 @gqchen @pearu @nikitaved @soulitzer @jianyuh @mruberry @heitorschueroff @walterddr @IvanYashchuk @VitalyFedyunin

issue.title: Fix gradcheck failing for OpInfo with TensorList inputs

repository.name: pytorch
repository.description: Tensors and Dynamic neural networks in Python with strong GPU acceleration

issue.body:
Stack from [ghstack](https://github.com/ezyang/ghstack):
* **#53418 Fix gradcheck failing for OpInfo with TensorList inputs**

This PR adds a workaround to OpInfo tests for ops that take TensoList inputs which were failing gradcheck (see https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/51996). It also updates the *stack ops to pass in a list of Tensors as input to SampleInput to demonstrate that the tests now pass without the need for defining a lambda in op.

issue.body:
Added a field to `OpInfo` to provide a wrapper function for gradcheck. This is useful for functions that need to perform some extra input/output processing to work with gradcheck.

fixes https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/50837
